say:2:1831017001:1.text: Long ago, back when I was a living child, my mother told me a story about a city beneath the sea.
say:2:1831017001:1.source_cn: 很久很久以前，在我还是个年幼的生者的时候，我的妈妈曾经...

say:3:1831017002:1.text: At the bottom of the sea stood a magnificent palace, home to all kinds of fish.
say:3:1831017002:1.source_cn: 在大海中央的深海里，存在着一座巨大的、华丽的宫殿，里面...

say:4:1831017003:1.text: One night, a storm swept a fisherman overboard. He found his way to the underwater city and traded a few ordinary things from the surface for bags of pearls.
say:4:1831017003:1.source_cn: 曾经有遭遇暴风雨的渔民落难，意外进入了那座城市。他用从...

say:5:1831017004:1.text: He returned home rich and never wanted for anything again.
say:5:1831017004:1.source_cn: 后来，他靠着那些珍珠发了大财，过上了富足的生活。

say:6:1831017005:1.source_cn: 多么浪漫的故事，是不是？

say:7:1831017006:1.text: Sounds like he found a good source of pearls and invented the fish city so no one else could steal it.
say:7:1831017006:1.source_cn: 哪里浪漫？那个人只是不想告诉别人他是在哪里找到珍珠的吧。

say:8:1831017007:1.text: ... Graveborn children stop being cute once they've lived this long!
say:8:1831017007:1.source_cn: ……活得太久的亡灵小孩真是一点也不可爱！
